## Channel: Йожеф Гісем
24 subscribers

### Description
18 views
Posted: 2026-11-10
Burnstate is a native Mac menu bar app for people who code with AI.

It shows your Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Vercel AI Gateway limits, marks how much of each window has passed, and tells you when you'd run out at your current pace.

• Pace every limit against the clock, with a run-out forecast
• Answer Claude Code permission prompts and questions from a card
• See every session's tokens, cost and models, from local logs
• Cooldown: break reminders that count only time away
• Burn report: a year of AI coding usage, shared as one link
• Desktop widgets [...] No account, no analytics, no Burnstate server.
Requires macOS 26.5 Tahoe or later.
